rongmei.title: Ai hei rianra pui ram khou bam lana

lines: 1. Ai hei rianra pui ram khou bam lana,
Houni e gun daihmei mun puanghpui ram,
Tam kanmei nzianmei guai ta,
Kanloumei Pu paan rui -
Riu dat pukhou neihla puni.
Adih neihlapui khuan kantu cho!
Ata zai gutlou o hei ram khou tei;
Hei kandi khou hei tam khuansini,
He! Tingkauh ram khou kapmei naidat lak khe.
2. He! Poubaomei rim gaimei munpuang e
Aram rianra guai Nang khou tigut re;
Kandih rianramei ning lak khe,
Pouh Jisu zailou o -
Nthanmei nun bampui ram khou.
3. Lungh rianramei tabui nung maanni cho?
Zianmei tam kan nimei guai ta zauna,
Mikdui keimei lungh rianramei,
He! Pouh Jisu Nang pam -
Khou zai guanga tigailou o.
4. He! Zianmei guai ta ntamlou lana,
Kapma huai bam e nzianmei guaita,
Nang ramgai tei ai zau bamni,
Gaichuipui ram tangh mak san.
Ai kapma handat lak khe.
